title: Finding Patterns
blurb: Every style has a place that teaches it: gates, holdfasts, stands, chests someone left behind and Hale's rack.

steps.text: Buy a pattern at Hale's rack.
Take a pattern from a gate: the creature on its first floor carries it.
steps.hint: It glints. Defeat it and the pattern goes straight into your pack.

steps.text: Find a pattern in a chest someone left behind.
steps.hint: The stone people out on the land sometimes still hold a key. Its tag says where the chest is.

steps.text: Take a pattern from a Pattern Stand.
steps.hint: Stands are built into vaults, monoliths, spires, hero-tree crowns and beasts' lairs.

steps.text: Buy a pattern from a holdfast's smith.
steps.hint: A holdfast's smith sells patterns of its land's level for emeralds.
Each style plays differently, so try them.

finish.line: You know where patterns come from.
